description: Tyre cost model for CarFootprint. Yearly tyre cost = 4 x (summer + winter price per tyre at the chosen rim size) x max(km/2 / life_km x EV factor, 1 / max_age_years). Each set covers half of the annual kilometres.

anchor.source: Easy Garage 24/7 price comparison 10.11.2026 (205/55 R16, Rengas Online): winter Nokian Hakkapeliitta R5 185.07 EUR, summer Nokian Wetproof 1 94.16 EUR per tyre. Rengas Online is one of the dearer shops in the comparison (pessimistic choice; cheapest 149.47 and 73.99 EUR).

rim_ratio_source: Median price per rim size of Nokian Hakkapeliitta R5 at Rengas365, read 19.11.2026 (15: 92.12, 16: 123.09, 17: 152.62, 18: 175.53, 19: 222.49, 20: 269.52 EUR), divided by the 16-inch median.
life_source: Summer tyre usually lasts about 30,000-35,000 km (Autonrengasliitto via Verkkouutiset); the lower bound is used, also for winter tyres (no km figure found).
max_age_source: Sensible maximum: 6 years in use or 10 years from manufacture (Autoliitto in Moottori).
ev_source: EVs can wear tyres up to 20% faster (Michelin); about 20% more wear per extra 450 kg (Emissions Analytics). Fleet data: first change about 10,000 km earlier (Epyx 2023).
misc_source: ADAC standard car-cost calculation: 250 EUR a year for washing and care (Germany, version 10/2026). Tyre changes and storage are not included in any source found.
